question: A cube of side 10 cm is cut into cubes of side 2 cm. Calculate the total surface area (in cm²) of all the small cubes:
solution:
**Given:**

Side of the large cube = 10 cm

Side of each small cube = 2 cm

**Formula used:**

Total surface area of all small cubes = Number of small cubes × Surface area of one small cube

Surface area of one cube = 6 × (side)²

Number of small cubes = (Volume of large cube) / (Volume of one small cube)

Volume of a cube = (side)³

**Calculation:**

Volume of large cube = 10³ = 1000 cm³

Volume of one small cube = 2³ = 8 cm³

⇒ Number of small cubes = 1000 / 8 = 125

Surface area of one small cube = 6 × (2)² = 6 × 4 = 24 cm²

⇒ Total surface area of all small cubes = 125 × 24 = 3000 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
